title: Cytotoxic and gene expression effects of deltamethrin and acetamiprid on MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells: a molecular and functional study.
authors: Akcay, Sevinc; Yalcin Azarkan, Serap; Ozkan-Kotiloglu, Selin; Celik, Sibel; Coskun, Bayram Furkan
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估农药对乳腺癌细胞的细胞毒性与基因表达影响，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The widespread use of pesticides such as deltamethrin (a pyrethroid) and acetamiprid (a neonicotinoid) has sparked concerns regarding their effects on human health, particularly their potential role in carcinogenesis. This study investigated the cytotoxic, molecular, and functional effects of these pesticides, individually and in combination, on the MDA-MB-231 triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) cell line. This model was chosen to specifically investigate estrogen recpetor (ER)-independent mechanisms due to its expression of targets such as aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma), and G protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER); however, it does not reflect normal mammary cell responses. Cytotoxicity was assessed via XTT assays, migration was analyzed using wound-healing assays, and gene expression changes in AhR, PPARgamma, and Caspase-3 were measured using RT-qPCR. Molecular docking was performed to predict pesticide-protein interactions, and in silico toxicity assessments using ProTox-II supplemented the in vitro results by predicting toxicity profiles relevant to public health. Both pesticides exhibited dose-dependent cytotoxicity, and their combination produced an additive effect on cell viability. Importantly, suppression of cell migration and downregulation of AhR and PPARgamma expression reflected toxic stress responses at high pesticide concentrations, rather than therapeutic or anti-cancer potential. While apoptosis-related gene expression (Caspase-3) was increased, this effect did not reach statistical significance. Molecular docking supported strong interactions with key pathways related to xenobiotic metabolism and apoptosis. These findings emphasize that, at high and non-environmentally relevant concentrations, deltamethrin and acetamiprid induce additive cytotoxic effects and disrupt molecular processes in a mechanistic cancer model. The results highlight the need for further investigation using normal cell systems and environmentally relevant exposures to clarify real-world risk and biological mechanisms, and should not be interpreted as evidence of therapeutic activity. This study underscores the mechanistic relevance of pesticide exposure in environmental toxicology rather than any potential therapeutic application.
abstract_zh: 溴氰菊酯（一种拟除虫菊酯）和啶虫脒（一种新烟碱类杀虫剂）等农药的广泛使用引发了对其对人类健康影响的担忧，尤其是在致癌过程中的潜在作用。本研究探讨了这些农药单独及联合使用对MDA-MB-231三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）细胞系的细胞毒性、分子及功能效应。选择该模型是为了专门研究雌激素受体（ER）非依赖性机制，因其表达芳基烃受体（AhR）、过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）和G蛋白偶联雌激素受体（GPER）等靶点；然而，该模型并不能反映正常乳腺细胞的反应。通过XTT实验评估细胞毒性，使用伤口愈合实验分析迁移能力，并利用RT-qPCR测量AhR、PPARgamma和Caspase-3的基因表达变化。进行了分子对接以预测农药-蛋白质相互作用，并使用ProTox-II进行计算机模拟毒性评估，通过预测与公共健康相关的毒性谱来补充体外实验结果。两种农药均表现出剂量依赖性细胞毒性，且其联合使用对细胞活力产生加性效应。重要的是，在高浓度农药下，细胞迁移的抑制以及AhR和PPARgamma表达的下调反映了毒性应激反应，而非治疗或抗癌潜力。虽然凋亡相关基因表达（Caspase-3）有所增加，但该效应未达到统计学显著性。分子对接支持与异生物质代谢和凋亡相关关键通路的强相互作用。这些发现强调，在高且非环境相关浓度下，溴氰菊酯和啶虫脒在机制性癌症模型中诱导加性细胞毒性效应并扰乱分子过程。结果凸显了使用正常细胞系统和环境相关暴露进行进一步研究的必要性，以阐明现实世界风险和生物学机制，且不应被解释为治疗活性的证据。本研究强调了农药暴露在环境毒理学中的机制相关性，而非任何潜在的治疗应用。
